notes.title: New game is coming! Qicaihuise will publish a new game "Comrade Trump's Re-ele
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today I am very happy to announce that we will act as an agent to release the new game "Comrade Trump's Re-election" developed by YEARS Studio!
This is a very interesting game to simulate the election process of Comrade Trump. Can Comrade Trump fulfill the task assigned to him by the motherland when he is Re-elected? There are rich questioning systems in the game. Each choice may bring different results. Of course, if you can't decide, you can also directly reprimand the reporter "FAKE NEWS"!
Whether to answer the reporter's questions seriously or to leave in anger depends on your choice.
Besides, how can Comrade Trump forget to tweet? Send a tweet to see how many likes you've collected!
The game has four endings, in addition to winning and losing two endings, there are two hidden endings.
"This is a hymn of loyalty!"

Qicaihuise is committed to bringing you countless colorful games. Why not add this wonderful new game to your wishlist right now!
We will release the game on September 11th, please don't miss it.
Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375870/Comrade_Trumps_Reelection/

notes.title: 关于《鬼畜大冒险》整改通知！
notes.notes: 今日刚刚公开了商店页面，受到四面八方的关注实在越来越多。鉴于群众的反馈，我们决定对游戏的内容做出一些整改。包括修正游戏的相似人设、原画等。声明一点的是：我们制作游戏的初衷是本着喜爱之情来创作，游戏中的所有绘图均是原创绘制的，并不是网络真人或视频素材，有点相似之处为了贴近鬼畜文化。给大家带来的不便之处深表歉意。游戏的发布日期很可能延期，希望大家多多谅解。
